[ ABOUT ]

Three developers, one shared standard.

Bracket Systems is Kylie, Prince and Jansen — full-stack and Java developers building web platforms, computer-vision tools and enterprise systems for businesses and institutions that need software that actually works.

[ WHO WE ARE ]

Builders first.

We started as freelance developers — Kylie has been building for clients since 2019 — and work across the whole stack: Java and Spring Boot backends, web front-ends, computer vision and OCR, and the infrastructure underneath.

Our client work covers computer vision for industrial safety, document systems for institutions such as Cavite State University, and business platforms for retail and services.

We also build our own product. HR & Payroll brings together what we've learned about records, access control and operations in one platform for Philippine companies.

[ HOW WE BUILD ]

What we care about.

  • Done means it works

    Software that ships and holds up under real use — for real clients and institutions — is the standard, not a demo that looks finished.

  • Practical over fashionable

    PHP and MySQL where they fit, Java and Spring Boot where they fit, computer vision where it earns its place.

  • Honest about limits

    We say what a system does today, what it doesn't, and what depends on how it's installed. Our product pages do the same.

  • Built for the people using it

    The payroll officer, the employee on a phone, the IT admin reading logs at night — each gets a tool made for their job.
